title: At the Bus Stop
text:
Ali is at the bus stop. It is cold today. He wears a warm coat. He waits for the bus.

A girl comes to the bus stop. Her name is Ece. Ali smiles at her. They wait for the bus together.

questions.text: How does Ali feel when the girl comes?
Why does Ali wear a coat?

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many people
not warm; with a low temperature
a warm piece of clothing you wear over other clothes
to stay somewhere until something happens

paragraph_translations: Ali otobüs durağında. Bugün hava soğuk. O sıcak bir mont giyiyor. Otobüsü bekliyor.
Bir kız otobüs durağına geliyor. Adı Ece. Ali ona gülümsüyor. Birlikte otobüsü bekliyorlar.
